### Revvity to Host Investor Day


10/06/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 92 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/908952201/files/doc_news/Revvity-to-Host-Investor-Day-2026.pdf)


WALTHAM, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Revvity, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Frevvity.com&esheet=54616461&newsitemid=20261006197122&lan=en-US&anchor=Revvity%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=fdeaa7acb77ac978a8154ac325aa158e) (NYSE: RVTY), today announced it will host its 2026 Investor Day on Friday, November 13 at 9:00 a.m. ET.


Presentations from members of Revvity’s senior management team will provide updates on the Company’s key business initiatives, operational achievements and financial outlook.


To register for the Investor Day webcast,[visit here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.webinar.net%2FXJgmYNrYpDn&esheet=54616461&newsitemid=20261006197122&lan=en-US&anchor=visit+here&index=2&md5=a597329eea1a19bb2927f0021d4a8352) . A replay of the webcast and all presentations will be available on the[Events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.revvity.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54616461&newsitemid=20261006197122&lan=en-US&anchor=Events&index=3&md5=b787b25bc3e78656e3c86a52b8f6fe12) page of the[Revvity Investor Relations website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.revvity.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54616461&newsitemid=20261006197122&lan=en-US&anchor=Revvity+Investor+Relations+website&index=4&md5=48560676f0c41f96ae570765778e7121) following the event.


**About Revvity**


At Revvity, “impossible” is inspiration, and “can’t be done” is a call to action. Revvity provides health science solutions, technologies, expertise, and services that deliver complete workflows from discovery to development, and diagnosis to cure. Revvity is revolutionizing what’s possible in healthcare, with specialized focus areas in translational multi-omics technologies, biomarker identification, imaging, prediction, screening, detection and diagnosis, informatics and more.


With 2025 revenue of $2.9 billion and approximately 11,000 employees, Revvity serves customers across pharmaceutical and biotech, diagnostic labs, academia and governments. It is part of the S&P 500 index and has customers in more than 160 countries.
